authorization: 用户：你可以用论文里宣称的数据
paper_title: PhysMani: Physics-principled 3D World Model for Dynamic Object Manipulation

task_success_reference.aggregation: mean and standard deviation over best 3 models from last 5 checkpoints

trajectory_reference.metric: predicted versus ground-truth target center Euclidean distance
trajectory_reference.scope: all 16 tasks, test trajectories, four camera views
trajectory_reference.ours_comparability: Our existing two-task VAL trajectory metrics have different horizons and aggregation; no direct delta is reported.

reporting_rules: Use full-framework task success for the primary comparison, never classifier AUROC or selected-subset success as framework success.
Mark paper values as reported by the authors; they are not local reproduction results.
Keep development resets separate from the original TEST benchmark.
Do not compute paired significance or success-rate deltas against paper aggregates.
The context plus SimNorm v1 is trained on TRAIN and undergoing controller-specific success collection; report formal TEST only from its frozen benchmark.
Primary PhysMani reference is Table 1, not the separately aggregated Table 4 ablation results.
